messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads up — Acme dedicated pool go-live planned Tue 09:00 PT. Need final quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and a short internal load test window. Customer flagged renewal sensitivity if perf regresses. Who owns what?
Ethan (SE): I can own quota numbers and traffic profile. Posting expected profile now.
Ethan (SE): `profile: peak_rps=250, avg_tokens=120, burst_factor=1.5`
Rachel (Ops): I'll draft autoscale policy. Thinking min=2, max=20, scale_up: qps+cpu, cool_down=60s. Also would like a cache warmup step before traffic. :thinking_face:
Leo (SRE): I'll run the internal load run Wed 14:00 PT and the smoke checks. Plan: `k6 run --vus 200 --duration 15m load-test.js`
infra-bot: Deployment window reserved for acme-pool on 2024-04-02 09:00 PT — reminder will post 1h before.
Maya (CS): Can we add a 30-min enablement walkthrough for Acme engs before cutover? They'll need the failover/runbook details. @Ethan @Rachel
Ethan (SE): Yes — Tue 07:00 PT works for me. I'll prepare runbook + rollback steps (short checklist).
Rachel (Ops): Adding dashboard links and autoscale runbook here: <https://redwood.internal/dash/acme-pool> and <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/autoscale-acme>. I'll also create an orchestration playbook entry for cache warmup.
Leo (SRE): Agreed on rollback criteria: if 95th latency regresses >2% or error rate >2% during soak, we rollback. Also will run a quick variant-fallback smoke: `curl -X POST https://acme-test.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'`
Maya (CS): Thanks. I'll loop AE for renewal signal and update the account-health doc. If we hit >5% errors or repeated timeouts, we escalate to oncall immediately.
Ethan (SE): Pushing load generator config to repo: `git push origin acme/load-config` — will paste link in the runbook.
Maya (CS): Final ask: capture customer feedback after first 24h (short checklist + one-question NPS-style), I'll create the feedback doc and schedule a 48h postmortem sync.
Rachel (Ops): Noted. I'll also wire a dashboard alert for token cost spike so billing surprises are caught.
Leo (SRE): I'll post results of the Wed soak in this thread with graphs and a short summary.
Maya (CS): Perfect — tagging this as owner matrix: quota=Ethan, autoscale=Rachel, soak=Leo, enablement=Maya. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
